Commercial glazing services in Canada

Every national service page below covers one job type—emergency board-up, measured storefront replacement, commercial door glass, or 24-hour security work. Start with the closest match to your opening; if a shattered door and a cracked fixed lite both need attention, tell dispatch on the same call so we load the right tempered sheets and hardware. Canadian plazas, restaurants, and office towers share the same phone line—share your address, photos, and whether the site must latch before morning.

Questions

Board-up vs replacement—which comes first?

Security first. We board or glaze temporarily, measure tempered or laminated glass, then install when the panel is ready.

Can one visit cover door and window glass?

Often yes—tell dispatch about both openings so we bring the right hardware and glass samples.

How do I book?
